title: i18n(platform-objects): ship the platform objects, Setup, Studio and Account in zh-Hant
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7v5H7BaFmL7sUCoN7tSxhm)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cya5ej5GQV86RPbRPK

Part of #30512 — package 11 of 11 (`@objectstack/platform-objects`), first of its seven locales: `zh-Hant`. Per the seat's ruling B, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de` and `ko` follow one PR each, and the last PR of the series makes the bundle check read the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 平台内置对象（用户、组织、会话、API 密钥、OAuth、SSO、SCIM、通知、邮件、任务、导入、元数据、设置、汇率等全部 `sys_*`）、Studio 里各元数据类型的配置表单、「设置」「Studio」「账户」三个应用的导航、系统概览仪表盘与数据集、平台页面标题，以及用户 / 组织记录页上的内联文案，补上繁体中文（zh-Hant）。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的最后一个包（platform-objects）的第 1 种语言。用繁中的管理员和开发者打开平台不再大面积看到英文。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；原有 4 种语言一字未改。新语言同样走「源文本哈希回退」，手写部分每条都记了源哈希。测试改动都是把 zh-Hant 加进各测试的语言列表（覆盖变宽，没有放宽断言），外加 cli 一个形状测试的语言码正则放宽到接受 `zh-Hant` 这种书写体子标签（否则它一个内联文案都认不出）。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/apps/translations/setup.translation.ts` 与 `src/metadata-translations/index.ts`（注册），`scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts`（`--locales` 加 zh-Hant），然后抽看 `zh-Hant.ts`（导航，约 140 条）和任一生成文件。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=platform-objects` 输出 in sync；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 本 PR 改动超过 3000 行（含生成物），按规程需人工合并；契约复核尚未做（contract review owed），复核通过后由席位请 os-zhuang / hotlong 审批。

## What changes

- **Generated bundles** `zh-Hant.objects.generated.ts` (1,674 leaves) and `zh-Hant.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (1,263 leaves), written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes` from the merge baseline, plus its provenance companion `zh-Hant.source-hashes.generated.ts`.
- **Hand bundle** `zh-Hant.ts` (138 leaves: the Setup, Studio and Account navigation, the System Overview dashboard, the datasets and the platform pages), with `zh-Hant.source-hashes.ts` recording the digest of the `en` source each leaf was translated from: all 138, so the first source edit under any of them falls back instead of serving a superseded translation.
- **Registration:** `SetupAppTranslations` and `MetadataFormsTranslations` serve `zh-Hant` through `withSourceFallback`, exactly as the existing three; the `apps` barrel exports `zhHant`.
- **Extract config:** its docstring's `--locales` (what `check:i18n` executes) and its merge baseline carry `zh-Hant`, so the gate covers the new bundles from this PR on. The root `pnpm i18n:extract` script still lists three locales; the final PR of the series moves both it and `scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` to the platform locale table.
- **Inline page copy:** the 42 inline locale maps on the user and organization record pages and the System Overview dataset's null label gain a `zh-Hant` entry.

## Tests

- Locale lists widened to `zh-Hant`, no assertion changed: in this package `plugin.translations.test.ts`, `setup-nav-per-user-stores.test.ts`, `sys-user-details-tab.test.ts`, `system-overview-null-label.test.ts` (these four pin the shipped set and go red without it), and the vocabulary, parity, tombstone, source-hash, BU-rename, metadata-forms, repeater, dashboard-header, confirm-question and identity copy tests (these iterate a fixed list, so `zh-Hant` is now held to the same bars).
- Cross-package pins held for `zh-Hant`: `plugin-security`'s People & Organization nav test (its control pins the Setup locale set and goes red without the new tag); `service-settings`' `setup-nav-hub-parity.test.ts` (each Setup sidebar entry reads as its hub card's title); `plugin-approvals`' `approval-status-vocabulary.test.ts` (the `my_pending` view label equals the account nav's `nav_account_approvals`: 待我核准).
- `packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts`: its inline-map shape test recognised a locale key as `xx` or `xx-YY` only, so with a `zh-Hant` key present it recognised no map at all (`expected 0 to be greater than or equal to 38`). The pattern now also accepts a script subtag; the 42 maps are found again and every one is complete in all five shipped locales.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** written for a Taiwan reader. Each leaf starts from the reviewed `zh-CN` text, converted with OpenCC's Traditional (Taiwan, phrases) table and then a house glossary of about 170 term rules that matches the `zh-Hant` bundles nine packages already ship (權限, 類型, 中繼資料, 工作階段, 權杖, 金鑰, 檢視, 欄 / 列 for column / row, 套件, 範本, 稽核, 共用, 指派, 核准, 電子郵件, 唯讀, 逾時, 背景工作, …). 446 leaves whose English and `zh-CN` pair already has a `zh-Hant` rendering elsewhere in the repo reuse it verbatim. Every one of the 1,541 distinct short leaves was read, and the long help texts were reviewed by sample and by a targeted audit of each rule that rewrites words in context (row / column, 應用 / 應用程式, 按 / 依, 通過 / 透過).
- **Mechanical checks, per leaf against `zh-CN`:** backtick spans, `{{holes}}`, `{holes}`, angle tokens and snake_case identifiers byte-identical (three intended differences, all Chinese prose inside a hole default or a JSON example: `default:'該成員'`, `"已封存"`); no Simplified-only character remains (the only s2t remarks are the Taiwan forms 台, 准, 群, 游, 里).
- **Cross-package wording pins carried:** `nav_account_approvals` = plugin-approvals' `my_pending` (待我核准); `nav_assignment_rules` = #30856's object name (指派規則); the queue, sharing, approval-delegation and HTTP-delivery entries read as their objects' `zh-Hant` labels; each `nav_settings_*` entry reads as its settings hub title from #30870 (so 郵件投遞 / 簡訊投遞 there, while the HTTP delivery log says 傳送).
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose:** the 40 `objects` leaves `zh-CN` already decided as echoes (`ID`, `JWKS`, `Client ID`, the SSO placeholders, …), each recorded by the extractor in `zh-Hant.source-hashes.generated.ts`, and three hand leaves (`Webhooks`, `Studio`, `AI`).
- **One cross-locale coincidence fixed:** `zh-CN`'s `action.fields.method.helpText` is the Latin `GET / POST / PUT / DELETE`, not the source; a converted copy made two locales agree on it and `check:i18n-stale-fill` reported it. `zh-Hant` now translates it (`HTTP 方法（GET、POST、PUT、DELETE）`); the stale-fill check passes with the baseline untouched. The `zh-CN` leaf itself is left as it is (existing fills are out of this card's scope).
- No string opens with `os ` followed by a lowercase word (`check-cli-command-ids` passes), and the whole "Lint · docs & code guards" lane was run locally before opening.
